metadata.description: Memory-focused MCP servers from NeuralNexusNote (working memory + long-term knowledge)

plugins.name: n3memorycore-lite
plugins.description: Working memory for AI agents — ephemeral (7-day TTL) hybrid vector + BM25 memory for Claude Code, backed by Redis Stack. Session-scoped by design; pair with N3MemoryCore Pro for long-term persistent knowledge. Requires a Redis Stack container running on localhost:6379 and uv (for uvx) on PATH.
